title: Play custom animations on the Lines when Codex asks for them
body:
## Change

Codex can now play a described animation on the Lines through the local MCP server. It switches the wall to Free with `nanoleaf_mode_set`, reads `nanoleaf_animations_list`, and calls `nanoleaf_animation_play` with a pattern (wave, gradient, pulse, breathe or sparkle), 1 to 8 colors, speed, direction and loop.

Refs #92. OpenSpec change: [`2026-09-25-gh-92-custom-animations`](openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-25-gh-92-custom-animations/) (synced into `integration-settings-api`, `device-worker` and `local-mcp-bindings`). ADR: [0014](docs/decisions/0014-requested-animations.md).

- **Command:** `animation.play` is a typed command in the Nanoleaf-owned `nanoleaf.integration/1.0` extension. Controller v1 and its vendored contract are unchanged. The controller validates the fields, the current revision, desired Free mode and the encoded effect before queueing. Work/Quiet requests are rejected as `unsupported-capability`; they consume no ticket and cause no write.
- **Receipts:** animations use the extension's existing request ledger with transport outcomes: `queued`, then `sent`, `failed`, `uncertain` or `cancelled`. `physicalOutcome` stays `unknown`. Any explicit mode command retires a queued animation with `stale-generation`.
- **Worker:** the Lines worker plays it as one journaled `PUT /effects` display write, with no streaming and no brightness or power write. A pending mode command (the Free handoff) applies first, then v1 controls and animations run in admission order. `bridge/effects.py` holds the frame encoder, now shared by the status display (payloads byte-identical), and the five pattern renderers.
- **Bounds (owner decision at the checkpoint, 2026-09-25):** at most 20 frames per zone and an 8,192-byte request. That stays inside the 9,009-byte middle-Line comet preview that passed live checks. No published firmware limit exists, and no live probe was run.
- **Hub compatibility (owner decision):** the hub's `validateIntegrationSnapshot` checks the extension snapshot's shape exactly. So options and limits come from a new read route, `GET /controller/integration/v1/animations`, and the snapshot keeps its exact 1.0 shape. Animation requests and receipts appear only in the submitting principal's `pending`/`outcomes`; the hub keeps its dedicated principal.
- **MCP:** `nanoleaf_animations_list` (read) and `nanoleaf_animation_play` (control). The play tool never switches mode. Its Work/Quiet failure carries a message to switch to Free with `nanoleaf_mode_set` and list again.

### Owner walkthrough (device command change)

- **State and writer ownership:** admission ([`integration_api.admit`](bridge/integration_api.py)) only queues a row in `integration_requests`. The single Lines worker ([`run_worker` `apply_controls`](bridge/bridge.py)) makes the write. Panels instances never read the extension ledger.
- **Timeout and expiry:** a queued animation expires after 30 s (existing extension recovery), and cancel, revocation and disable retire it. Tests: `test_cancel_revocation_and_expiry_retire_before_send`.
- **Duplicates and replay:** an identical request joins or replays its receipt; different content under one ticket conflicts. The worker marks the row `attempting` and commits before the send ([`attempt`/`play`](bridge/integration_api.py)), so an attempt is never sent twice.
- **Restart:** worker startup finishes any `attempting` row as `uncertain` (`test_worker_restart_finishes_an_interrupted_attempt_as_uncertain`).
- **Important failure test:** `test_failed_send_ends_uncertain_and_is_never_replayed`. A raising display write ends `uncertain`/`possible` and the next worker pass sends nothing. The race test `test_mode_committed_while_the_attempt_is_recorded_prevents_the_send` commits a mode change between the durable attempt and the send and expects no write.
- **Diagnosis and recovery:** read the receipt through `GET /controller/integration/v1/receipt`, or through the tool's replay with the same ticket. `uncertain` may have reached the device and is never retried automatically. A new animation needs a new explicit request.
- No existing test assertion was weakened. Two tests that hand-copy bridge modules (`test_controller_cli`, `test_prism_assets`) now also copy `effects.py`; the installer already globs `bridge/*.py`.

## Validation

Commands ran from the worktree with Node 24 (`fnm exec --using=24`) and `TMPDIR` under `.local/scratch/gh92/`.

- [x] `python3 scripts/check.py`: **504 tests OK** at `ed0ea1c` (production code unchanged since; later commits are the archive and docs).
- [x] `npm run test:mcp` (verify, 66 tests, typecheck): exit 0.
- [x] `npm run check:workflow` exit 0; `npm run test:workflow` 10/10 pass, at `298ba68`.
- [x] `npm run test:browser`: see the follow-up comment. The wall map is unchanged, but the status encoder moved.
- [ ] Hardware validation: not run. Live playback needs the owner's explicit request (issue acceptance criterion 3).

TDD evidence (red before each production step, green after):

| Step | Red before the change | Green after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Encoder and patterns | `python3 -m unittest test_effects`: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'effects'` | 12 tests OK |
| Encoder extraction | Golden capture of 48 status payloads (Work/Quiet pulses, comet, locate, Project whole coverage, Panels) before the change | `cmp` identical after (65,619 bytes) |
| Extension admission and options route | 5 errors: `'App' object has no attribute 'integration_animations'` | 5 OK |
| Worker playback and journal | 6 failures and 3 errors: no animation write after the handoff, `OSError not raised`, no retirement on mode change, `module 'integration_api' has no attribute 'attempt'` | 12 OK (whole file) |
| TypeScript consumer fixtures | `check.ts`: `Error: animation-minimal` | 39 requests, 4 configuration and 5 animation receipt fixtures pass |
| MCP tools | Tool list lacked `nanoleaf_animations_list`/`nanoleaf_animation_play`; animation tests failed | 66 tests pass |

Worst-case encoded size on the 15-Line fixture: breathe 7,896 bytes, pulse 7,656, gradient 6,216, wave 5,496 and sparkle 5,226, all within the 8,192 cap. `test_cap_stays_below_the_live_verified_comet` pins the cap below the comet.

## Review and CI

Pending; recorded in comments against the frozen comparison.

- UI changes: No (no wall map, `wall.html` or wall server change).
- Human approval for this UI candidate: not applicable.

## Installation impact

Source-only. No schema migration: new rows use the existing `integration_requests` table and a new `attempting` phase value that older source ignores.

- Source revision and validation: this PR's head; see Validation.
- Installation status and owner: not installed; installation needs an explicit owner request.
- Physical/controller verification: not run. The issue's live check (two animations, each after a switch to Free) waits for the owner's explicit request.
